# Wyrd — full machine-readable reference

Generated from `crates/wyrd-spec/schemas/`. Source of truth lives in Rust types under `crates/wyrd-spec/src/`.

## AgentCard

Declare an agent that Wyrd can describe, govern, evaluate, install references for, and observe. Execution stays in the user or framework runtime.

URL: https://wyrd.ai/cards/agent/
Schema source: crates/wyrd-spec/schemas/agent_spec.json

URL: https://wyrd.ai/cards/artifact/

## AuditCard

Represent a reviewable event or decision that needs durable provenance.

URL: https://wyrd.ai/cards/audit/
Schema source: crates/wyrd-spec/schemas/audit_spec.json

```json

              "type": "string"
            },
            "schema_hash": {
              "maxLength": 64,
              "minLength": 64,
```

## DataCard

Describe a dataset, feature table, document set, or other data dependency.

URL: https://wyrd.ai/cards/data/
Schema source: crates/wyrd-spec/schemas/data_spec.json

## ExperimentCard

Group work-in-progress runs and candidate changes under a single intent.

URL: https://wyrd.ai/cards/experiment/
Schema source: crates/wyrd-spec/schemas/experiment_spec.json

```json
      "description": "Credential references required by this tool.",
      "items": {
        "$ref": "#/definitions/CredentialRef"

      "description": "Hook matcher metadata.",
      "type": "object"

      "description": "MCP server name.",
      "type": [
        "string",
        "null"
      ]
    },
    "name": {
      "description": "LLM-visible tool name.",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "output_schema": {
      "description": "Output schema."
    },
    "requires_approval": {
      "default": false,
      "description": "Whether approval is required before use.",
      "type": "boolean"

      "description": "Script tool config.",
      "type": "object"
```
